packet.vertex_coordinates: D3D NDC, positive Y up, depth 0..1
packet.external_resources: v2 blobs may use a size high-bit marker and 64-byte SHA256 name beneath <packet>.blobs; content verified before GPU use

extensions.3: Q6 scene-linear premultiplied RGBA16F plus R8 validity; explicit depth/blend; final rect and exposure
extensions.4: per-draw shader namespaces, compatible attachment contracts
extensions.5: optional per-draw shared b1 frame buffer; UINT32_MAX means absent

cache_identity: owned packet postprocessor executable and input

parity_v1.purpose: controlled same-packet port regression, not art-direction scoring
parity_v1.silhouette_mask: nonzero alpha for transparent map frames; frozen RGB != background9 otherwise

ownership: A module and fixture live in its owner's paths. Q0 baseline adapter remains read-only to visual owners. No owner edits another module to render.

linear_branch.validity_attachment: R8_UNORM; only opaque writes establish map validity
linear_branch.reconstruction: invalid source samples contribute zero; average premultiplied color/alpha, then unpremultiply
linear_branch.display: Q6 exposure once, max-channel shoulder, exact IEC sRGB, straight BGRA8
linear_branch.output_conversion: shared CPU reference; excluded from GPU duration
